children: According to CNBC, Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman will join Becky Quick, Joe Kernen and Andrew Ross Sorkin for a "First on CNBC" interview at 8:45 a.m. ET on Friday. Microsoft shares have risen 31% over the past three months, making it the best-performing Magnificent Seven stock in that period, and the stock closed Thursday up just under 3% for the year to date.

title: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman To Appear On Squawk Box Friday
